title: Raise the API gateway body limit to 100 MB
author: Marcus Chen
text:
Raise the API gateway body limit to 100 MB

## Summary

Upgrades Envoy to 1.31 and raises the request body limit on the gateway from 10 MB to 100 MB. Load-tested with 95 MB payloads; p99 latency unchanged. The old 10 MB limit was a default we never revisited.

## Changes

- Config change with the new value and a comment pointing at this PR
- Unit tests updated for the new behaviour

## Testing

Load-tested against a copy of production traffic.

Reviewers: Kwame Boateng, Priya Natarajan
